# Make List Online
> Browser-Based List Formatter, Deduplicator, Sorter & Markdown/HTML Converter

## Project Overview
Make List Online is a high-speed, zero-dependency client-side utility built to convert unstructured plain text lines into clean, standardized list formats including bulleted, numbered, Markdown checklists, HTML tags, CSV strings, and JSON arrays.

## Canonical URL
https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/listmaker/

## Core Features
- Real-time serialization into Bulleted (•), Numbered (1.), Markdown (- [ ]), HTML (<ul><li>), CSV, and JSON formats.
- Instant deduplication: Purges repeating lines and displays exact count of removed duplicates.
- Alphabetical sorting with full Unicode collation (A-Z and Z-A) and Fisher-Yates random shuffling.
- Custom Prefix & Suffix injection: Add quotes, SQL wrappers, or custom tags around every line simultaneously.
- White-space trimmer and blank-line eliminator.
- 100% Client-Side Privacy: All text manipulation runs locally in the browser with zero server transmission.

## Target Audience
Writers, web developers, data analysts, students, project managers, and content creators organizing multi-line data.
